Give Users More Control Over AI Music Recommendations. As AI-generated music becomes more common on Spotify, users should have more control over how it affects their recommendations. Instead of simply blocking AI-generated music, Spotify could introduce a personalized AI music preference. Users could choose to prioritize human-made music, include AI-generated music normally, or have a balanced mix of both. Spotify could also clearly label when a song contains AI-generated content and, when possible, indicate how much AI was involved in its creation. This would give listeners more transparency and control over their recommendations while still allowing them to discover new music. It would also make the recommendation system feel more personalized and trustworthy
